assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one polished, cinematic landscape key-art header for the independent Windows horror FPS roguelite THRESHOLD. Wide 12:5 composition for a 2400 x 1000 launcher banner. A frightening empty maze of aging yellow wallpaper offices, low acoustic-tile ceilings with a few dim fluorescent tubes, damp worn beige carpet. Impossible corridor openings and a single battered office chair partially intersecting a wall convey surreal Backrooms geometry. The main focal point is an ordinary wallpaper wall with three strips of matte dark blue painter's tape forming an unfinished rectangular doorway, with tape overshooting at the corners; wallpaper remains inside, no literal blue door and no magical portal. Peripheral corridors disappear into near-black shadows. Restrained bodycam lens curvature, faint analogue VHS grain and color fringing, strong photographic material detail. Dirty ochre, charcoal and a small cobalt blue accent. Original promotional concept artwork, no HUD, no people, no monsters, no text, no logos, no watermark. Leave enough calm shadow areas for launcher UI without making the art unreadably dark. Full bleed image.
